name: CC-the-door-forced
note: The clouds built the first frame whatever the driver says: the page waits on the march's compile again (seconds on D3D11).

name: CC-not-started-at-the-mount
note: A sky whose switches the boot read otherwise compiles its clouds only from its first draw.

name: CC-started-without-the-extension
note: Where the driver compiles in line, the mount queues seven links that hold the page's next GL read.

name: CC-shown-before-the-first-sweep
note: The dome's decks stand down the frame the clouds are built, and the sky shows neither until their first sweep.

name: CC-the-recenters-lost
note: A recenter before the build is dropped: the late clouds sample their field away from where a boot build would.

name: CC-the-viewport-not-restored
old: const built = new VolumetricClouds(gl, quality, buildViewport);
note: The build restores the whole buffer's viewport, and the sky's draw goes on in it instead of the world rect.

name: CC-the-sky-switched-by-the-build
note: The dome's decks stand down before the clouds have a sweep to draw: frames with a bare sky.

name: CC-the-sun-dimmed-twice
note: The key light drops the dome's occlusion before the ground reads the clouds' map.
